recall_prompt: Say which coefficient is largest in each expansion and why — what an even n gives and what an odd n gives.
insider_note: One answer for (i) and TWO for (ii): even n has a single largest coefficient, odd n has an equal middle pair. Giving only one of the pair is the usual half answer.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Even case (i)
steps.margin_note: First mark. For even n the largest binomial coefficient is the middle one, ⁿC with lower index n/2.
steps.memory_tip: Even n has ONE largest coefficient, the middle one with lower index n/2.
lines: (i) n = 24 is even, so the largest coefficient

recall.must_convey: That for n = 24 (even) the largest coefficient is the middle one, ²⁴C₁₂.
accept: n is twenty four which is even so the largest coefficient is the middle one twenty four C twelve
even n gives one largest coefficient n C n by two
twenty four C twelve is the largest
n twenty four even kabatti twenty four C twelve largest
the middle coefficient of an even power is the biggest

steps.why: Binomial coefficients rise to the middle and fall again symmetrically; with n even there is exactly one middle.
common_mistakes: Giving two coefficients for an even n.

steps.label: Odd case (ii)
steps.margin_note: Second mark. For odd n the two middle coefficients are equal and both are largest.
steps.memory_tip: Odd n has TWO equal largest coefficients. Give both ¹⁹C₉ and ¹⁹C₁₀.
lines: (ii) n = 19 is odd, so the two middle coefficients
are equal and largest: ¹⁹C₉ = ¹⁹C₁₀

recall.must_convey: That for n = 19 (odd) the two middle coefficients ¹⁹C₉ and ¹⁹C₁₀ are equal and largest.
accept: n is nineteen which is odd so the two middle coefficients nineteen C nine and nineteen C ten are equal and largest
odd n gives two largest coefficients n minus one by two and n plus one by two
nineteen C nine equals nineteen C ten and both are largest
n nineteen odd kabatti nineteen C nine and nineteen C ten rendu largest
the two middle ones tie for largest

steps.why: With n odd there is no single middle; ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₙ₋ᵣ makes the two central coefficients equal.
